<description>
A mempool.dat entry with a time in the future is loaded as it is, so its transaction never expires, whatever -mempoolexpiry says.

I use the current time for such an entry. Earlier times are unchanged. Open PR #36540 removes time-based expiry, which would make this change moot. I tested this with a functional test that restarts a node with its clock behind a saved entry time. It fails without the change and passes with it.

This is one of several PRs from a large audit of Bitcoin Core that I did with the help of LLM tools. The audit produced its evidence all at once, which is why the PRs arrive together. I understand each change fully and will answer review questions myself.
</description>

diff --git a/src/node/mempool_persist.cpp b/src/node/mempool_persist.cpp
index 691acb7f02..ca5163d762 100644
--- a/src/node/mempool_persist.cpp
+++ b/src/node/mempool_persist.cpp
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@
 #include <util/time.h>
 #include <validation.h>
 
+#include <algorithm>
 #include <cstdint>
 #include <cstdio>
 #include <exception>
@@ -94,6 +95,9 @@ bool LoadMempool(CTxMemPool& pool, const fs::path& load_path, Chainstate& active
 
             if (opts.use_current_time) {
                 nTime = TicksSinceEpoch<std::chrono::seconds>(now);
+            } else {
+                // An entry time in the future would keep the transaction from ever expiring.
+                nTime = std::min<int64_t>(nTime, TicksSinceEpoch<std::chrono::seconds>(now));
             }
 
             CAmount amountdelta = nFeeDelta;
diff --git a/test/functional/mempool_persist.py b/test/functional/mempool_persist.py
index 86e99ec473..ddbc092d3c 100755
--- a/test/functional/mempool_persist.py
+++ b/test/functional/mempool_persist.py
@@ -198,6 +198,20 @@ class MempoolPersistTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
         self.test_importmempool_union()
         self.test_persist_unbroadcast()
         self.test_importmempool_malformed()
+        self.test_future_entry_time()
+
+    def test_future_entry_time(self):
+        self.log.debug("Check that an entry time later than the current time is clamped when mempool.dat is loaded.")
+        node0 = self.nodes[0]
+        now = int(time.time())
+        node0.setmocktime(now + 3600)
+        txid = self.mini_wallet.send_self_transfer(from_node=node0)["txid"]
+        assert_equal(node0.getmempoolentry(txid)["time"], now + 3600)
+
+        # The mempool is dumped on shutdown with the entry time in the future.
+        self.restart_node(0, extra_args=[f"-mocktime={now}"])
+        assert_equal(node0.getmempoolentry(txid)["time"], now)
+        node0.setmocktime(0)
 
     def test_importmempool_malformed(self):
         self.log.debug("Check that importmempool fails on a malformed mempool.dat.")

</patch>
